02 / OUR EXPERTISE

OUR SERVICES

Capability across the
asset lifecycle.

Subsea positioning and IMR, AI-native digital business platforms, remote operations, and robotics. Connected expertise to support your assets and operations.

01 / SERVICE

Subsea Positioning Services

Inertial subsea metrology and specialist support to establish the relative position and orientation of subsea connection points. We connect offshore measurement, remote data processing, and pre- and post-fabrication dimensional control to support jumper and tieback fabrication and installation.

Scope includes inertial metrology equipment, remote technical support, hub geometry and orientation measurement, dimensional verification, and reporting against project tolerances.

Explore the workflow ↗
02 / SERVICE

Subsea IMR

Inspection, maintenance, and repair support for subsea infrastructure. We combine field expertise, specialist equipment, and delivery partners to assess asset condition and support project-specific intervention requirements.

Scope includes subsea inspection, offshore survey, non-destructive testing, maintenance and repair support, and integrity reporting.

03 / SERVICE

AI-Native Digital Business Platforms

Digital platforms that connect business processes, operational data, and AI-assisted workflows. We develop solutions that help teams manage information, coordinate work, and make informed decisions across their operations.

Scope includes business workflow automation, ERP integration, AI assistants, asset management, digital twins, and operational dashboards—with role-based access and human approval where required.

04 / SERVICE

Industrial Remote Operations

Connect field operations with remote expertise through live video, telemetry, and shared operational workspaces. We support remote monitoring, technical review, and collaboration between site teams and specialists.

Scope includes remote operations centre integration, equipment and inspection dashboards, remote data processing, specialist support, and secure field connectivity.

05 / SERVICE

Industrial Robotics

Development and integration of robotic systems for industrial inspection, cleaning, and monitoring. We bring together sensing, controls, navigation, and operator interfaces to support practical field applications.

Scope includes robotic system development, payload integration, mission visualization, operator interfaces, and inspection data integration.
